summary: People call it "cool without trying," and that is the perfect entry point: shaggy Jarmusch deadpan, low-key criminal drift, and a hangout vibe that gets funnier the longer it sits.
good_pick_if: you want something dry, stylish, and easy to lounge inside
maybe_skip_if: you want punchier jokes or stronger plot mechanics

summary: People call it "funny and furious," and that balance is the whole reason it lands: lived-in friendship chemistry, real urgency, and dialogue with genuine snap.
good_pick_if: you want a sharp contemporary drama with real momentum
maybe_skip_if: you want something less confrontational or more muted

summary: People describe it as "eerily simple," and that is the trick: an extremely calm comedy where every blank stare somehow turns into sharper and stranger satire.
good_pick_if: you want something dry, weird, and gently devastating
maybe_skip_if: you want fast jokes or broader emotional cues

summary: People call it "basically perfect," and it is easy to see why: crackling banter, big-city romance, and a movie that feels comfortable without ever feeling lazy.
good_pick_if: you want a rom-com with real charm and replay value
maybe_skip_if: you want less sentiment or less talk

summary: People call it "deranged in the best way," and that is exactly the promise: a wild premise that stays funny, sly, and weirdly committed to human pettiness.
good_pick_if: you want an offbeat comedy that actually gets stranger as it goes
maybe_skip_if: you want normal people behaving normally

summary: People call it "funny through the tears," and that gets the tone exactly right. It is intimate, affectionate, and full of family detail that makes the emotion feel earned.
good_pick_if: you want a warm drama with quiet emotional accuracy
maybe_skip_if: you want hard edges or less family pain

summary: People call it "Hollywood hell wallpaper," and that is half the pleasure: a pressure-cooker nightmare comedy with sweat, dread, and very funny despair.
good_pick_if: you want something funny, claustrophobic, and increasingly cursed
maybe_skip_if: you want comfort or a stable emotional register

summary: People call it "joyfully scrappy," and that is the best non-spoilery pitch. It starts rough on purpose, then turns into one of the most generous crowd-pleasers around.
good_pick_if: you want a funny, inventive group watch and can trust the setup
maybe_skip_if: you want instant polish or zero patience upfront

summary: People call it "sweet and bruised," which feels dead on. It has kid-eye wonder, goofy humor, and just enough sadness to keep the warmth from turning sugary.
good_pick_if: you want something funny, tender, and a little offbeat
maybe_skip_if: you want sharper satire or less childlike energy

summary: People call it "way too charming," and that still lands as the cleanest recommendation: smart teen-romance banter, huge charisma, and a soundtrack-first good mood.
good_pick_if: you want an easy, high-chemistry rom-com
maybe_skip_if: you want something less glossy or less teen-coded
